sample.title: Verify successful login with valid credentials
steps: Enter a registered and valid email address into the 'email' input field.
Enter the correct password into the 'password' input field.
Verify the user is redirected to the main application page or dashboard.
Verify a successful login message is displayed.

sample.title: Verify login attempt with an invalid email format
steps: Enter an email with an invalid format (e.g., 'test@domain', 'user.com', 'plainaddress') into the 'email' input field.
Enter any valid password into the 'password' input field.
Assert that a validation error message is displayed indicating the email format is incorrect.
Assert that the user is not logged in.

sample.title: Test for SQL Injection Vulnerability in Login Form
steps: In the 'email' input field, enter a common SQL injection payload, such as `' OR '1'='1' --`.
In the 'password' input field, enter any random string.
Verify that the authentication fails and the application returns a generic error message.
Confirm that no database-specific error is exposed and that unauthorized access is not granted.
